prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star composition for a desktop landing page, 16:10 landscape.
Input images: Image 1 is the actual RoleRadar dashboard and supplies only palette, typography character, sharp/4px component grammar, thin rules, and believable data styling. Image 2 is composition option A; it proves the visual world but must not be repeated. Create a materially different topology.
Primary request: Design composition option B, “Source Ledger,” for RoleRadar’s brand-new marketing landing page. It must read immediately as an internship discovery product and as a real website, not a poster.
Structure: thin navigation at top; an oversized two-line proposition sits in the upper-left quadrant, while the entire lower two-thirds behaves like a wide editorial ledger. Source names and raw posting fragments enter in several horizontal lanes from both outer edges. Near the center, the lanes cross one narrow dark-forest vertical “intake” column labeled LIVE INTAKE, then continue as perfectly aligned RoleRadar rows on the other side. Avoid a conventional left-copy/right-mockup split. Let the data infrastructure itself span the first viewport. The first hint of the next scroll section appears along the bottom.
Exact visible text: “RoleRadar”; “Every source. One live shortlist.”; supporting line “New internships surface while they’re still new.”; primary action “Browse Internships”; nav links “How It Works” and “Sources”; small labels “LIVE INTAKE”, “12 sources scanning”, “Updated just now”.
Hero mechanism: horizontal source lanes labeled Company careers, GitHub lists, Startup boards, LinkedIn, University resources, ATS feeds. Raw fragments become normalized role rows as they pass through the intake column. Show realistic roles including Software Engineering Intern — Toronto, ON — Posted 8 min ago; ML Engineering Intern — Remote Canada — Posted 21 min ago; Frontend Intern — Vancouver, BC — Posted 37 min ago.
Focal moment: a single full-height dark-forest intake seam turns scattered source lanes into a clean unified ledger.
Style/medium: sophisticated production web UI screenshot, restrained editorial operations aesthetic, strong condensed grotesk typography, hairlines and tabular data as the visual material, polished and buildable.
Color palette: warm stone #f2f0e9, paper #fbfaf6, dark forest #17201b / #15201a, signal lime #d9ef70, muted gray-green.
Constraints: one primary CTA; asymmetric reading order; sharp geometry; minimal rounded containers; no invented customer logos, testimonials, usage claims, pricing, or browser chrome; headline and CTA immediately visible.
Avoid: repeating option A’s large left column plus right feed, centered hero, badge, bento grid, feature cards, glassmorphism, gradients, glowing blobs, huge pills, 3D forms, illustrations, photography, device mockups, sparkles, excessive blur, purple, generic SaaS styling. No watermark.
